problem: Production cross-browser baseline found 73 failures across 247 public routes, dominated by CLS above 0.1 and stale interaction selectors.
root_cause: Shared header controls changed geometry after first paint and the browser harness targeted obsolete navigation selectors.
decision: Reserve final desktop language/mobile menu geometry in shared header, target canonical product route and actual controls, preserve CLS threshold 0.1, and test PRs on exact Netlify preview.
prevention: Shared header geometry is regression-tested before JavaScript.
Browser assurance uses real navigation controls.
No CLS threshold widening is allowed.
Daily production and PR preview screenshot assurance remain enabled.
